name: MESSY WORKSHOP
text: Every surface is cluttered with salvaged
parts, tools, and scribbled blueprints. The
air smells of ozone, old oil, and stale
coffee.

name: TALL PARTS CABINET
text: A towering metal cabinet packed with numbered
bins holding various bits of scrap. A thick
red wire snakes out from one of the lower
shelves, pooling on the floor.

name: TOOL PEG BOARD
text: A well-organized pegboard displaying wrenches
of all sizes, along with screwdrivers and
analog gauges. It's the only tidy spot in the
entire room.

name: PARTIALLY ASSEMBLED ROBOT HE
text: A salvaged robotic casing rests on the desk,
one optical sensor glowing a faint, warm
orange. Wires spool out from the exposed neck
joint onto scattered schematics.

name: HAND-DRAWN BLUEPRINTS
text: Large sheets of paper covered in detailed,
hand-drawn diagrams for what looks like a
mechanical joint. Several crumpled drafts are
tossed haphazardly around them.

name: PILE OF SCRAP
text: A dark green, angular piece of casing sits
next to a rusty barrel and a box overflowing
with curved metal components. They look heavy
and coated in grime.

name: SERVICE LIFT SCHEDULE
text: A digital display board protected by a cage,
showing a grid of names and numbers. The text
is blocky and pixelated, glowing in amber and
white.

name: LOOSE BLACK CABLE
text: A thick, heavy-duty cable snakes out from
under the workbench, curling loosely on the
floor near a dark stain.

name: LOWER HARDWARE BINS
text: These plastic bins are overflowing with
assorted fasteners and small, greasy fittings.
The labels are smudged beyond readability.

name: UPPER HARDWARE BINS
text: Rows of small gray bins holding tiny,
indistinguishable metal parts. Some are pulled
out slightly, as if recently rummaged through.

name: STACKED PAPER INVOICES
text: A messy stack of papers piled near the edge of
the desk, some spilling over the side. They
look like old requisitions or manifests.

name: LOWEST HARDWARE BINS
text: The bins nearest the floor are mostly empty,
save for a few loose screws and a thick layer
of workshop dust.

name: SORTING BIN
text: A clear plastic bin labeled 'MODEL' containing
what looks like small gears and casing
fragments. It's shoved in tight next to the
others on the crowded shelf.

name: WIRE STORAGE BIN
text: This bin is stuffed with tangled spools of
wire and thin cabling. The label below it is
mostly peeled off.
